name: CCS Abwicklungs AG
summary: Compleo Charging Solutions AG develops, manufactures, and sells charging stations for electric vehicles and wall boxes in Germany, the European Union, and internationally. The company provides alternating current (AC) and direct current (DC) charging stations for public, semi-public, fleet, and employee charging or residential charging of company cars. It also develops, produces, and distributes products enabling electric mobility, as well as provides related services. In addition, the company provides turnkey projects, including project planning, installation of charging stations, commissioning, and after sales services. Its customers include municipal utilities, fleets, car dealerships, operators, and real estate industry. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Dortmund, Germany.
